name: Series templates
summary: One JSON script becomes a whole series of cards with the same badge, progress bar, hook, window and closer.
qualityBar: validateSeries catches a banned claim word, text too wide at 42 px, an unknown page type, 5 items, a missing icon, a missing title, a too-wide hook, a bad brand and a 3-line compare line
All 5 episodes of the sample series pass the engine quality checker with no hard failure
Across episodes the lesson pill is centred and at the same height, the dots differ by episode number, and the window title bar is pixel-identical at the same time
frame(t) is pure: the same frame twice and out of order hash the same
The 7.5 s demo has no motion gap over 0.5 s, keeps text clear of the safe zones, and ends with the engine closer
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size (38 checks passed, 0 failed; 5 sample episodes each passed the engine checker; demo rendered 1080x1920, 7.5 s, silent; checker on card and mp4 passed with 1 transient warning). I viewed out/contact.png and out/series_sheet.png and judged them good. NOT checked: motion judged from stills, not played back by a person; the series was only built with 4 page types and 5 episodes (the 12+ episode rail variant is only checked for green pixels in one frame, not looked at); not run against a ported real card (that is covered by t6.2, t6.4 and t6.5).
